import struct

def get_mantissa_bit(float_val, bit_pos):
    # Get the specific bit of the mantissa at position bit_pos
    bytes_val = struct.pack('f', float_val)
    int_val = int.from_bytes(bytes_val, byteorder='little')
    
    # The mantissa is in the least significant 23 bits
    mantissa = int_val & 0x007FFFFF
    
    # Get the bit at the specified position
    return (mantissa >> bit_pos) & 1
